title: The Ascension
reflectionQuestion: Jesus promised to be with his friends always, even after he went to heaven. When do you feel that God is close to you?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (extra, emotional room = JESUS IS STILL WITH US). Bridges the gap between Empty Tomb (1812) and Pentecost (1845) -- completes the Jesus arc. Per Adam: HOPEFUL, not sad -- Jesus blesses them, promises 'I am with you always' + the Spirit, then rises; the angels' gentle 'why are you looking up at the sky?'; the friends go home with JOY, not grief. The not-alone spine. NO long (full-only): one luminous moment (blessing -> rising -> angels -> joyful return); complete at full, a long would stretch it. mood encouraging. 'God'/'Jesus' throughout, no Yahweh. VOICE_JAMES_HUSKY (wise elder -- steady hope).

scriptureKeyVerse.text: who also said, “You men of Galilee, why do you stand looking into the sky? This Jesus, who was received up from you into the sky, will come back in the same way as you saw him going into the sky.”
